_note: What the little one says when the farmer talks to them (Talk, README.md, Villagers; Game._talk_child): the crawler babbles, the toddler has a few words of their own, the child talks of the yard, the morning's weeds (flag help_weeds), the festival and the spouse's work they went along to (flags married_<id> and the maps of that work). The first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; `stage` (a list of Child stages) picks by the age. %s is the child's name, put in by Child.named_dialogue before the box opens (each line is translated as a pattern, the name with it). The gift_ lines answer the toddler's gifts by reaction (gifts in data/child.json); the crawler takes none. No he / she: the name, they, the little one. Our own lines.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Ba-ba-ba! Bwah! (%s pats the tatami, very pleased with the noise.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Mmm... ah! (%s crawls over and grabs a fistful of your sleeve.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Eeh-heh-heh! (%s laughs at nothing at all, and then at you.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Buh? (%s holds up a fist and opens it. Nothing inside. Wonderful.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Aaah... (%s yawns a huge yawn and rubs one eye with a fist.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Ah! Ah! (%s crawls straight to you as fast as small knees go, arms up.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Hee-hee! (%s tries to say your name. It comes out as a bubble.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Mm. (%s is busy chewing on a corner of the cushion.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Bah. (%s has found a patch of sun on the mat and is watching it.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I can count to a hundred now. Well, to twenty. Then it gets fuzzy.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Did you know beetles have six legs? I counted. One of them didn't like it.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: When I'm big, I'm going to grow a turnip as big as the house. A small house.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Morning! Goro and I are going to check the whole field. For bugs. And treasure.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I pulled weeds before breakfast! The roots go all the way down. I won.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: It's a festival! Everyone's here and everything smells good. Can I stay up late?

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I saw the lanterns and the stalls and a cat! Today has too many things in it!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I'm helping at the store! I put the radishes in a row. Sayo says it's a very straight row.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Fumi let me carry a cup. Just the empty one. I didn't drop it even once.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Haru showed me how to twist straw. Mine came out lumpy. Haru said lumpy is a start.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: The kiln is so hot! Ichiro says stand back. I'm standing back. Way back.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Mio let me look in the traps! There was a crab. It waved at me. Rude.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I'm helping Kaede rake the gravel. You have to make the lines go round the stones.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Look, my fingers are blue! Shino says it washes off. In about a week.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I'm carrying the post with Ren! Well, one letter. It's very important.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Goro found a hole and I found a stick. We're a good team.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I'm watching the field grow. It's slow. I'll watch a bit longer.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: It's raining, so I'm making a boat out of paper. It sank in the cup. Next one won't.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: When you're out in the field, I watch from the door. You're the best farmer there is.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I saved you the biggest strawberry. Then I ate half. The other half is still yours.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I'm busy! Goro and I have important work. It's a secret.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: (%s waves, then runs off after a dragonfly.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Look! Look! I walk! ...Oops. I sit.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Bird! Big bird! It go flap-flap-flap!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Mine. ...Okay, yours. ...No. Mine.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Up! Up, up! ...Again! Again!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Morning! Is it morning? It's morning!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: You home! I waited. I waited a looong time.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I love you this much! (%s throws both arms out wide and sits down hard.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Rain go plip-plop. I stay in. I make a fort.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Snow! I eat it. ...Cold! Cold, cold!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Goro! Goro, sit! ...Goro no sit.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Dirt! Good dirt! (%s holds out a handful, very proud of it.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I help farm! I dig hole. Here. And here. And there.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Goro lick my face! ...Again, Goro!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Busy. I'm busy. Rock pile.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: (%s waves at you, then goes back to chasing a moth.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: For me?! Sweet! Mmm! Thank you, thank you!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Ooh. For me? Thank you!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Hm? ...Okay. (%s puts it on a pile of treasures.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Bleh. No. (%s hands it back with a frown.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Yuck! Yucky! (%s scrunches up their face and pushes it away.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: More? No. You gave me already. Silly.
